I changed `_git_cmd` in `app/workspace.py`. When the caller passes `text=True` without `errors`, it now sets `errors="replace"` and, if no encoding was given, `encoding="utf-8"`. An explicit `errors` argument is left alone, and non-text calls are unchanged.

The independent check is to run `_git_cmd(['printf','a\xe3\x81b'], capture_output=True, text=True)`. It should return a string with U+FFFD in place of the cut byte instead of raising `UnicodeDecodeError`. The same call with `errors='strict'` should still raise. I couldn't run it because Bash is disabled in this session, so the change is untested.
